mobileKit._help: All of the kit's settings for this app live here. Edit the lists under "release"; the kit manages nativeBaseline and apkTag itself.

release._help: Decides APK or OTA for you. "apk": folders/files (globs) that need a new APK when they change, e.g. "modules/**". "ota": folders/files that are safe over the air, e.g. "assets/fonts/**". Built in: app/**, src/**, tests, docs, *.md are OTA; android/**, ios/**, patches/**, plugins/** are APK. A changed file in neither list builds an APK to be safe, and the release says which file to list.
release._apk_builtin: Always an APK, no need to list: android/**, ios/**, patches/**, plugins/**, eas.json, metro.config.js, babel.config.js. Also any new or upgraded native dependency, config plugin or native app.json field (found automatically from package.json and node_modules). Below: our own folders. assets/images/** holds the app icon, adaptive icon, splash and favicon, which are baked into the native build.
release._ota_builtin: Always OTA, no need to list: app/**, src/**, __tests__/**, *.test.*, *.spec.*, docs/**, backend/**, scripts/**, .github/**, **/*.md, .gitignore, .gitattributes, .editorconfig, .prettierrc*, .eslintrc*, LICENSE. package.json, lock files and app.json are judged by what changed in them, not by name. Below: our own folders. assets/** covers the sounds; kaitet-web/** is server-side Frappe code; the rest is root tooling. 'apk' wins over 'ota', so assets/images/** stays native. A folder in neither list builds an APK to be safe.
